description:
Goal: remove the definition-time env machinery that is telemetry-only dead weight, now that __ENV__ is projected at expansion via a namespace splice (fz-rh2.28.4) and the lexical context is carried by FunctionSource.namespace.

Pivot: the original goal ("carry the definition env on FunctionSource") was wrong and its commit was reverted. Investigation showed the definition-time env projection only ever fed the env_root_ref telemetry measurement; nothing functional consumed it. __ENV__ in a body is now a projection of the def scope, spliced at expansion. So the def-time env path is dead.

Scope (remove): FunctionEnvSource enum, the function_env resolution, the env param threaded through publish_function_source, and the env_root_ref telemetry (update source_publish_test.rs:132).

Keep (Elixir-essential, do NOT remove): FunctionSource.namespace (the lexical context = cache_env); the __CALLER__ runtime-param mechanism; the __CALLER__ arg the def-head macros pass to Fz.Compiler.define (the Elixir-aligned def-site capture seam).

Signal: FunctionEnvSource gone; no def-time env projection; full lib green; fixture_matrix unchanged (313/85 baseline); zero warnings. Behavior-preserving (telemetry-only removal).

comments.text: Dependency note: blocked by fz-s00 (the phase-vs-origin / read-source-once step), which replaced the deleted fz-rh2.28.2. Where the description says "Depends on fz-rh2.28.2," read fz-s00.

Superseded approach: env is NOT carried. __ENV__ is projected from the def scope and spliced via NamespaceSymbol::Splice at expansion (landed in fz-rh2.28.4). This ticket now covers only the deletion of the leftover telemetry-only def-time env scaffolding.

title: Compiler2: remove the telemetry-only definition-time env scaffolding
